summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement for $[blank] aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Barrier Notes due October 18, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Russell 2000 Index, and S&P 500 Index. The notes are senior unsecured obligations issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. Issue price is $1,000 per note; the call premium reflects approximately 9.80% per annum; the pricing date is October 9, 2026, and the original issue date is October 19, 2026. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation.
